sentences.text: Nerruku Ner -LRB- Face to Face -RRB- is a 1997 Tamil dramatic thriller film written and directed by Vasanth and produced by Mani Ratnam .	Vasanth	Vasanth	Mani Ratnam	Mani Ratnam	Tamil	Tamil cinema	dramatic	drama film	thriller film	thriller film

Raghuvaran , Shanthi Krishna , Karan , Vivek , Manivannan and Prakash Raj form the ensemble cast , while Deva and K. V. Anand handled the film 's soundtrack and cinematography respectively .
